label: doc_capacity_metrics_forbidden
description: Built from the documented schema, not recorded live: executeQueries without dataset Build permission. The status and body are copied from the 403 the same principal received from the refresh-history endpoint (WS5); what executeQueries really answers to a caller without Build is not verified.

queries.query:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    21000,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'TimePoints'[TimePoint],
        TREATAS({"00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a0"}, 'Capacities'[capacityId]),
        FILTER(ALL('TimePoints'[TimePoint]), 'TimePoints'[TimePoint] >= (DATE(2026, 10, 21) + TIME(12, 0, 0)) && 'TimePoints'[TimePoint] <= (DATE(2026, 10, 21) + TIME(12, 30, 0))),
        "CuPercent", [CU %],
        "InteractiveDelayPercent", [Interactive delay %],
        "BackgroundRejectionPercent", [Background rejection %]
    ),
    'TimePoints'[TimePoint], DESC
)
ORDER BY 'TimePoints'[TimePoint] ASC

error.message: Api accessed by user <eupi>00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa</eupi> with insufficient privileges. request is unauthorized, identity None.
